Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class SellerReviewService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.SellerReviewService
public class SellerReviewService extends Object
Task 2.9 Review and Feedback Handling: the reviews buyers left for the seller's completed deals, and the two things the seller can do with one (Manage Reviews).
  • Reply - one reply per review (A2), never empty (A3); the buyer who wrote the review is told with a NotificationCategory.REVIEW_REPLY notification.
  • Flag - marks an inappropriate review for the admin (Review.isFlagged()); a already flagged review is "already awaiting moderation" (A4), and an NotificationCategory.ANNOUNCEMENT notice puts it on the admin's board.

Only the seller of the reviewed deal's listing may act on a review, and every method starts with the role check, like the other seller services. A hidden review is not in getMyReviews(): the admin hid it from the marketplace.

    • reply

      public void reply(String reviewId, String reply)
      Replies to one review and tells the buyer (Manage Reviews steps 3-5).
      Parameters:
      reply - the seller's reply; required, and stored without surrounding spaces
      Throws:
      AccessDeniedException - if the logged-in user is not a seller
      ServiceException - if the review is not on the seller's listings, already has a reply, or the reply is empty; nothing is changed then

    • flag

      public void flag(String reviewId)
      Flags one review for the admin as inappropriate (Manage Reviews step 6). The admin's notification board gets an entry, so the flag is seen without the admin watching the ratings screen.
      Throws:
      AccessDeniedException - if the logged-in user is not a seller
      ServiceException - if the review is not on the seller's listings or is already flagged
